name: retrotunes
description: Late-2000s Brushed-Metal Desktop Media Player, Homelab Media Gateway, & Universal ePod Sync Engine

scripts.build:mtp: mkdir -p .toolchain/bin && clang -O2 -Wall -Wno-deprecated-declarations -framework IOKit -framework CoreFoundation native/rtunes_mtp.c -o .toolchain/bin/rtunes-mtp || true
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:mtp && npm run build:electron && vite build
